workload.note: Rookie; no 2025 NFL workload. Played QB for LSU in 2025.

contract.note: Rookie contract; among the first 2026 Chiefs draft picks to sign (atozsports.com).

scheme.note: Drafted by Kansas City in Round 7 (249th overall) of the 2026 NFL Draft (nfl.com, Wikipedia). Chiefs OC changed for 2026: Eric Bieniemy returns to the role (his 6th time as KC OC), replacing Matt Nagy. HC Andy Reid continues.

competition.name: Justin Fields
competition.note: Acquired via trade from Jets in 2026 offseason; clear backup ahead of Nussmeier.

notes: arrowheadaddict.com (Jun 3, 2026) depth chart: QB1 Mahomes, QB2 Fields, QB3 Nussmeier, QB4 Chris Oladokun (practice squad since 2022) - Nussmeier is QB3, buried on the depth chart as a developmental prospect.

injury.note: No injury reported for Nussmeier as of Aug 11, 2026 in sources checked.
